verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ تَبَّتْ يَدَآ أَبِى لَهَبٍ وَتَبَّ
verses.translation: Destroyed were the hands of Abu Lahab, and he lay utterly doomed.

verses.arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
verses.translation: His wealth did not avail him, nor his acquisitions.
Surely, he will be cast into a Flaming Fire
along with his wife, that carrier of slanderous tales;
upon her neck shall be a rope of palm-fibre.
